adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (lines ~10-13 in the added code). When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50), this returns 3 instead of 2, creating a phantom empty last page. The diff also shows `next` can set `offset` up to `user_count`, and `findMembers` allows `offset == user_count`, which would fetch an empty page consistent with this off-by-one.
